title: compat.covenant-status/1.0
description: POST /api/v1/ai/covenant-status (phase 5): the bank app's AiStatusRecommender contract: the same request and response bodies (AiStatusRequest / AiStatusRecommendation records), but the call needs DPS's service token (Authorization Bearer, role SERVICE). Certificates: the ones named in certificateFileIds (DMS version ids), else the newest certificate DPS read for the CP; read by EXTRACT_CERTIFICATE or AUTO; a covenant is matched by its measure code, metric and name. Answered in at most 10 s from results DPS already extracted; never parses a file inside the call; an empty list means 'AI unavailable'. Only certificate figures a person confirmed or corrected count (a job waiting for review or run in SHADOW gives none).

rationale.description: Cites the certificate or evidence page it relies on
